blocks.text: Will Ashley said he and Mika Salamanca are choosing to focus on the positive aspects of their careers and their budding romance amid criticism of their personal relationship. In a recent ambush interview following the media conference for their afternoon series “Delivery Boi,” Ashley acknowledged that negative comments are inevitable in the entertainment industry. “Well, kasi sa industriya po natin, hindi na maiwasan ‘yung mga ganyan.
